h1: Custom Cup Lead Times: Plan from Approval to Arrival
lead: Separate design, samples, production and transport when planning a custom-cup order. Your required arrival date is not the same milestone as factory completion.
html:
Identify the development route

An existing cup with artwork needs a different sequence from a new cup shape. New geometry adds structure and tooling work before the physical sample. Specify whether the sample must show the base product, the decoration or a new molded structure.

Keep approvals on one version

Send the selected model, material, artwork, quantity and packing together. A change to the cup, logo or components after sampling can change the work still needed. Record the artwork and sample version used for the production instruction.

Plan the shipping handoff

Give the destination and arrival requirement at the beginning of the inquiry. EXW, FOB Shenzhen, C&F and DDP are available by agreement. Payment is 30% deposit with the balance before shipment. Production and sample dates belong to the project quotation; no fixed site-wide number of days is promised.
